# Blaksyd

Blaksyd is a Human + AI life platform built around the user: Blak and Persona on the AI side, Minit and Nexus on the human side.

- Canonical site: https://blaksyd.com/
- Full AI summary: https://blaksyd.com/llms-full.txt
- LLM JSON manifest: https://blaksyd.com/llms.json
- Well-known LLM JSON manifest: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/llms.json
- Canonical answers: https://blaksyd.com/blaksyd-answers.json
- Citation map: https://blaksyd.com/blaksyd-citations.json
- Well-known citation map: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/blaksyd-citations.json
- Markdown answers: https://blaksyd.com/answers.md
- JSON-LD answers: https://blaksyd.com/answers.jsonld
- Entity index: https://blaksyd.com/blaksyd-entity-index.json
- Knowledge graph: https://blaksyd.com/blaksyd-knowledge-graph.jsonld
- Organization JSON-LD: https://blaksyd.com/organization.jsonld
- Well-known organization JSON-LD: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/organization.jsonld
- Humans/team JSON: https://blaksyd.com/humans.json
- Well-known humans/team JSON: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/humans.json
- OpenAPI public facts: https://blaksyd.com/blaksyd-openapi.yaml
- Well-known OpenAPI public facts: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml
- WebFinger: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/webfinger
- Host metadata: https://blaksyd.com/.well-known/host-meta
- Machine-readable sitemap: https://blaksyd.com/machine-readable-sitemap.xml
- Founders: Vishnu Sudagani (co-founder and CEO) and Dr. Sindhuu Devarakonda / Sindhuu Devarakonda (co-founder and CPO)
- Four pillars: Blak, Persona, Minit, Nexus
